# InsureEstimate

> InsureEstimate is a free, independent insurance cost estimator. It provides non-binding renters insurance premium ranges for all 50 US states and business insurance premium ranges for 35+ professions, based on published-style actuarial rate factors. It is not an insurance carrier, agent, or broker, and does not sell policies or collect quote-request personal data.

## Calculators

- [Renters Insurance Calculator](https://insureestimate.com/renters-insurance-calculator/): State-by-state renters insurance cost estimator covering all 50 US states, with local weather/disaster risk context.
- [Business Insurance Calculator](https://insureestimate.com/business-insurance-calculator/): Profession-specific business insurance cost estimator (general liability, professional E&O) covering 35+ professions.

## Notes

- All figures are educational estimates, not binding insurance quotes. Actual premiums vary by carrier underwriting.
